Prebuilt DLL attribution
========================

File: prebuilt\TbhAutoSynth-next.dll
Source: https://github.com/preschian/tbh-presence
Original path in source repo: autosynth/prebuilt/TbhAutoSynth-next.dll
Plugin author: preschian (TbhPresence/TBH Auto Synthesis)
Plugin version (per source): 0.24.0 [next/resilient]
Build type: Patch-resistant (built with /define:RESILIENT, which resolves
obfuscated members by signature at runtime so game patches no longer require
a manual remap).

We DO NOT commit this DLL to this repository. You obtain it directly from
preschian's releases: https://github.com/preschian/tbh-presence/releases

License
-------
The plugin source is published by preschian under the terms stated at
https://github.com/preschian/tbh-presence . We do not redistribute the
binary; we link to it. This file exists to (a) document where the binary
came from, (b) make the dependency explicit so any auditor can find the
original source for inspection, and (c) avoid any ambiguity about which
version of the plugin our orchestrator is designed to interface with.

Configuration we expect to be set by cube_launcher.ps1
------------------------------------------------------
[Timing]
AfterFillSeconds = 1.0
AfterSynthesisSeconds = 4.0
CycleIntervalSeconds = 300

[General]
AutoStart = false
AutoOpenCube = false
SynthesisTypes = Equipment,Materials,Accessories

[Safety]
MaxGrade = 2

Plugin status JSON we observe (read-only, never written by us)
--------------------------------------------------------------
Path: %LOCALAPPDATA%\tbh-companion\autosynth-status.json
Format (truncated, from Plugin.cs):
  {"version":"0.24.0","auto":<bool>,"phase":"<Fill|Synth|Clear>",
   "cycles":<int>,"lastCount":<int>,"lastGrade":<int>,
   "maxGrade":<int>,"cycleIntervalSeconds":<int>,"updatedUtc":"<ISO-8601>"}

What we do with it
------------------
Our orchestrator.py reads this JSON via mtime fast-poll (read-only) and
prints changes to orchestrator.log. We do not write to it. We do not
toggle keys, click anything, or invoke the plugin. The user owns F8.
